[b]Chaska[/b]
One of the oldest son's of Chilla and Chatay, Chaska  has a strong body of human and a head and claws of Ukúchû (Sùpâchó bear, a large mountains bear with large body and enormous strength, unbeatable to any animal on it habitat), Chaska has a colossal strength and power, alongside a robust body, he usually is equiped with a silver slingshot and a golden mace, he is the god of strength, bravery, war and thunder, as his [i]roar is strong as a hit from a thunderbolt[/i].
Bearer of a massive strength, being unbeatable by any mortal or god of his generation.
[i]His claws have a shining silver glow while his eyes make a terrifying fire glaze, his [b]Chillawáràk[/b](silver slingshot ) and  [b]Chataychámpi[/b] (Golden mace) are among the strongest weapon in entire [b]Wachay[/b](universe) , a single stone of the Chillawáràk can wipe out mountains of existence, while the Chataychámpi can smash mountains, the few only weapons that can make the gods bleed.[/i]
Adored by the soldiers, Chaska is not a deity full of bloodshed, contrary to some versions, he is not cruel or bloodthirsty, but he loves wars, as is the "max proof of bravery and strength", but he despises cowards, those who fight war without honour are "punished", this means, those who betray allies, attack others on a moment of "special" weakness (like during a holiday) or attack for no reason weaker kingdoms without even trying to make them submit, the punishments are severe, including:
[b] Ukúchû hunt Season [/b]: When Ukúchûs down the mountains and attack cities and hunt down humans, it is seen as signal that someone did a "dishonoured act", such as abandon of battlefield even doing a oath of loyalty.
[b]Strength Collapse:[/b] those who attack weaker in a unfair competition or war are cursed by Chaska and their muscles paralyze, and they can no longer move properly.
[b]Eternal forgetting [/b]: Those who use war for commiting dishonoured acts, such as civil massacring, suffer the most severe punish Chaska could do to a mortal, those who suffer from this punishing are [b]completely erased from history [/b], memories vanish, and no one will ever remember they existed , not their families, nor anyone they ever meet.
Chaska will appear in front of the person who made such horrid crime and will hit their head with the Chataychámpi, not just their very soul will vanish, preventing from even Wápìwan or Táncuy getting it, the memories from anyone who meet that person will disappear as well, this punishing is so feared that even it name was erased from history, reserved for only the worse of the worse people this punishment was made for.
[b]The Thunder of Chaska [/b]: Those who betray their allies or homeland for greed or something like , receive a thunderbolt right over their head and turned into nothing but ashes.
[b] Eternal March [/b]: Those who leave combat without any reason are condemned to march eternally for the rest of their lives, no one will ever accept them, and they will never stop until dying of exhaustion.
[b]Cry of thousands[/b]:a "minor" punishing for those who kill innocent people or their own allies, Chaska will make them suffer from eternal grieves of warriors and people they betrayed and killed, eventually, the person will fall into insanity.
_____________________________________________________
Abilities list:
Immortality : as any deity, Chaska is immortal.
Divine strength : stronger than any god of his generation, Chaska could easily be compared to gods of even previous generations.
Thunderbolt scream: a powerful roar that sounds like a thunder, it can make even the bravest tremble.
War tactic and knowledge: in fact, Chaska is a master on war not just for doing the brute force job, but as well as a leader, a actuall leader of a army, he can make even the least moralized army become inspired by his presence(which can also be a inspiring aura power).
Mester of weapons:  Chaska is master on every single weapon of combat and war.
Resistance: as any deity, Chaska has a incredibly high resistence.
Control of thunders: can invoke thunders and use it to attack enemies as he wishes.
Thunderstorms control: as he wishes, Black clouds of thunderstorms may follow Chaska whenever he goes.
War wrath : the more Chaska fights, the stronger he gets, the more he gets hurt, the stronger he gets, in order to counter this would be needed a single strong power to make him be destroyed or be imprisoned.
Divine jumps: as it was shown on one of his myths, when he jumps, can be in large distances and when landing can causes Erene tremble and alter even the mountains.
War essence: if somehow his body is destroyed, Chaska will always live as the concept of war, bravery and strength, inhabiting all the warriors and brave people who still live.
Final Tempest: [i] When Chilla and Chatay age come to a end, the sky will become red of blood, and the legions of warriors loyal to Chaska will emerge and challenge the skies to a final battle deciding the fate of the Camác, Samantemán and Wápìwan will fall beneath, and a new generation of warriors will begin to rule.[/i]

[b]Chaska kills an Amáru.[/b]
Descending from the top of Chomuñapû he did, with a imponent powerful body of man and Ukúchû he came down as he heard about the emerging of a Amáru, a fearless creature indeed, that until that time only a mortal killed, Chaska, never going to give up for a challenge, soon jumped his way to where the Amáru was,  his jumps made Camác tremble, and the mountains had now "spiky" parts marking his jumps over the Fárapû.
The creature he found had a gigantic body, it spitted fire at him, but Chaska did not shake one inch, in fact, he just made a simple shield of thunder around him, and then jumped on the back of the creature, who tried to struggle against Chaska, who then with his powerful claws ripped of the Amáru's wings, making it no longer capable of flying, now it was no longer a threat for escaping, Chaska put his hand to the skies , and then the Chatay responded, the Chataychámpi surged, and then was hit against the Amáru's back, paralyzing and insta killing it.

[quote=sal-baliz;58768483][b]The Village - Part 2[/b]
On the evening of March 11th, a small group of Sal-Baliz soldiers were sent to Al-Qasr. News had come to the Islamic council that the residents of this small village did not follow pure Islam. After around 30 minutes of looking around the village, the soldiers split up and began breaking into peoples houses. They cold-heartedly stabbed innocent civilians to death in an attempt to please Allah. The residents began to rally against them, so they called in back up. A team of 20 Sal-Baliz soldiers, armed with AK-47s arrived at the scene. Bullets soon began to fly in all directions. Nobody could escape the wrath of the Sal-Baliz, no matter how hard they tried. The sound of gunfire echoed through the desolate expanse. Soon, all that was left of the residents was piles of dead bodies, overflowing with blood. The soldiers immediately got to work cleaning up their mess, by burning the evidence. The sky was lit up orange as house after house was set alight. This incident remains a horrible reminder to the people inside the Sal-Balizs controlled territory that they will not tolerate dissent.[/quote]
[b]
Official Statement from the Government of Etherniasti[/b]

It is with profound horror and utmost condemnation that the Government of Etherniasti responds to the tragic and reprehensible events that occurred on March 11th in the village of Al-Qasr. The brutal massacre of innocent civilians by Sal-Baliz forces, purportedly in the name of religious purity, is an affront to humanity itself.

The Etherniasti government vehemently rejects any justification for such barbaric actions, which are nothing short of crimes against humanity. Religious belief should never serve as a pretext for violence or oppression. We affirm our unwavering stance on protecting human rights, religious freedom, and the sanctity of life.

We extend our deepest condolences and heartfelt sympathies to the families of the victims and to all affected by this tragedy. The international community must unite firmly against such atrocities, demanding accountability from those responsible.

The Leader of Etherniasti, Reginold the 3rd, has personally expressed his disgust and sorrow at this event and has called upon all civilized nations to take immediate diplomatic action, exerting pressure to ensure such heinous acts never occur again. Etherniasti stands ready to assist and support efforts aimed at restoring peace and justice for the people suffering under Sal-Baliz oppression.

In solidarity with those affected, Etherniasti will also be increasing humanitarian aid to victims of violence and repression in regions suffering from extremist actions. We call for international cooperation in condemning and preventing any repetition of these atrocities, ensuring that the dignity and safety of every human being remain paramount.
